complaints.metaDescription: FreClean complaints and dispute resolution process for service issues, product concerns, billing questions, and formal review pathways.
complaints.title: Complaints & Dispute Resolution | FreClean
complaints.intro: FreClean welcomes feedback on service quality, product issues, billing questions, communication, and any concern that may require a formal review.
complaints.purposeDetails: We aim to resolve complaints fairly, promptly and in a way that is proportionate to the issue. This page sets out the public process for raising concerns about a product, service, payment, communication, or agreement.
complaints.earlyContact: Where possible, complaints should be raised directly with FreClean as soon as the issue is identified. Early communication helps us review the matter, gather relevant details, and identify a suitable remedy.
complaints.submissionDetails: Customers may raise a complaint by email at
complaints.submissionEvidence: . Please include the relevant date, service or product description, the issue experienced, any supporting photos or documents, and the expected resolution.
complaints.caseEvidence: When a complaint relates to a specific order, quote, service request, or payment, FreClean may ask for the confirmation message, invoice, receipt, or other evidence needed to review the matter fairly.
complaints.reviewDetails: FreClean reviews each complaint based on the information provided, the agreed scope of work or product details, and any record of communication between the parties. A complaint may lead to a clarification, correction, refund review, service remedy, apology, or other practical resolution.
complaints.escalation: Where a matter raises broader or more serious concerns, including product safety, misconduct, or repeated service failure, it may be escalated internally for a more formal review and a documented decision.
complaints.outcomeDetails: FreClean will communicate the outcome of the review as clearly as possible and explain whether the request is accepted, partially accepted, declined, or referred to a different process. If a dispute remains unresolved, a customer may request a reconsideration or may contact the relevant local authority or consumer protection channel, where applicable.
complaints.records: FreClean keeps records of complaints and resolution decisions to support accountability, consistency, and service improvement over time.
complaints.formalContact: For formal complaint or dispute concerns, email
complaints.framework: for the broader framework governing public information and customer communications.

refund.metaDescription: FreClean refund policy describing review procedures for eligible service and product refund requests.
refund.openGraphDescription: FreClean refund policy for customer review and reimbursement decisions.
refund.title: Refund Policy | FreClean
refund.intro: FreClean reviews refund requests case by case. A refund is not automatic and depends on the exact service, product, payment route, and verified issue.
refund.eligibleDetails: Refunds may be considered for agreed service cancellations, product issues, confirmed disputes, or documented failures to meet the agreed outcome. The final outcome depends on proof, timing, and the terms established directly with FreClean at the time of the request.
refund.thirdParty: Where a third-party provider or the USDT or CeloHT payment route is used, final settlement and timing may be governed by that provider’s terms. FreClean does not claim to control settlement timing for every payment method.
refund.requestDetails: Customers should contact FreClean with the transaction reference, the request or order details, the reason for the refund, and any supporting materials. FreClean may request further information before issuing a refund or alternative remedy.

returns.metaDescription: FreClean returns policy for public service requests, product enquiries, and return review procedures.
returns.openGraphDescription: FreClean returns policy for product and service review decisions.
returns.title: Returns Policy | FreClean
returns.intro: FreClean reviews return and exchange requests based on the specific item, the request details, and any applicable local or product-specific obligations.
returns.details: Service and product requests are not automatically eligible for a return or exchange. A return request must be reviewed directly and may require proof of purchase, confirmation of product issues, or a service issue discussion.
returns.physicalProducts: For physical products, product condition, packaging, quantity, lot, and relevant product safety information may affect the outcome. For services, scheduling or scope changes are reviewed based on the actual agreement and any direct confirmation exchanged between the customer and FreClean.
returns.requestDetails: with the order, product, service request, and issue details. FreClean may request additional information before deciding on a return, exchange, credit, or other remedy.

shipping.metaDescription: FreClean shipping policy covering delivery expectations, shipping methods, customs, duties, and product movement for public orders and enquiries.
shipping.openGraphDescription: FreClean shipping policy for product movement and delivery expectations.
shipping.title: Shipping Policy | FreClean
shipping.intro: FreClean distinguishes the product price, shipping fee, tax, duties, and delivery timing based on the actual order and the shipping route. Shipping terms are confirmed directly.
shipping.customerDetails: Customers should review the product price, shipping method, shipping cost, tax, duties, customs obligations, and product restrictions before finalizing an order. FreClean does not promise a delivery date without direct confirmation.
shipping.availability: Shipping availability depends on destination, product eligibility, customs requirements, and operational capability. Some items may be restricted or unavailable in certain jurisdictions.
shipping.fulfillmentDetails: FreClean may confirm shipment method, tracking, dispatch timing, and final destination details directly with the customer. If a route is unavailable or restricted, FreClean will explain the limitation before completing a purchase or fulfillment action.

aboutCopy.c025: A Haitian business with a practical purpose.
aboutCopy.c026: FreClean was founded in Haiti on April 16, 2025, and is rooted in Léogâne, Ouest. It brings professional cleaning services and consumer products together with an entrepreneurship initiative and community-oriented support.
aboutCopy.c027: FreClean's starting point is practical care for the spaces where people live, work, and welcome others. The business is developing related products, commercial relationships, and participation opportunities from that foundation, without overstating its current scale or reach.
aboutCopy.c031: Useful care. Practical opportunity. Responsible growth.
aboutCopy.c032: Make practical cleaning and household-care solutions more accessible while creating practical pathways for entrepreneurship, economic participation, and community development.
aboutCopy.c039: One company, connected areas of work.
aboutCopy.c040: Each area has its own scope, availability, and terms. A website enquiry is a starting point, not confirmation of a service, sale, or partnership.
aboutCopy.c043: Cleaning enquiries for homes and apartments, kitchens and living spaces, workplaces, businesses, hotels, Airbnb and other guest properties. Deep cleaning and tailored requests depend on the service scope and availability.
aboutCopy.c044: Location, scope, timing, price, and confirmation are discussed for each request. Not every service is available in every location.
aboutCopy.c048: The current public range includes an all-purpose cleaner, Linen Breeze room freshener, and a FreClean-branded bracelet. FreClean is building practical solutions for everyday cleaning and household care.
aboutCopy.c049: Product stock, sizes, final pricing, and pickup or delivery arrangements are confirmed directly before purchase.
aboutCopy.c053: FreClean welcomes enquiries from offices, hotels, Airbnb operators, property managers, businesses, organizations, and hospitality teams.
aboutCopy.c054: Recurring cleaning, property care, product supply, customized arrangements, and commercial partnerships are discussed case by case; no contract or availability is guaranteed.

aboutCopy.c057: Entrepreneurship is a core FreClean pillar. The public affiliate pathway centers on learning about products, responsible promotion, and developing customer relationships.

It offers professional cleaning enquiries for homes, workplaces, and guest properties; cleaning and household-care products; fragrance products; and branded items. FreClean is developing an entrepreneurship pathway centered on eligible product knowledge, responsible promotion, and customer relationships. A community-support initiative may support eligible entrepreneurship and practical community activities. FreClean distinguishes current listings from developing work and long-term ambitions. Service coverage, inventory, pricing, program eligibility, and contribution instructions require direct confirmation by FreClean. No scale, outcomes, or income are guaranteed.
aboutCopy.c229: FreClean is a Haiti-based cleaning services and consumer-products business founded by Johnny Dubic on April 16, 2025, with its initial operating area in Léogâne, Ouest. The company focuses on professional cleaning, cleaning and household-care products, fragrance products, business solutions, entrepreneurship, community-oriented support, and partnerships. Its public service and product pages invite enquiries; scope, schedule, availability, prices, and next steps are confirmed directly. FreClean's affiliate pathway is based on eligible product participation, product knowledge, responsible promotion, and customer relationships. It does not promise income, employment, or business results. A separate contribution initiative supports eligible entrepreneurship and community activities; contributions are manually handled, are not investments, and are not represented as tax-deductible. FreClean is building from its Haitian foundation and describes broader regional participation as a long-term ambition, subject to capacity, resources, partners, and execution.
aboutCopy.c231: Johnny Dubic is the founder of FreClean. He is responsible for the company's strategic development during its current stage. No additional personal or professional biography is currently verified for this press kit.
